本轮将分析页已有的杯赛小组积分与联赛积分分开保存。输入为前轮冻结的原始响应，不重新抓取、不调整比赛时间、不更改原基础版本及冻结预测。两源可能共享上游；一致不等于独立证明。本轮所有数据保持历史代理，不证明目标决策时点可获得。


## 解析、核对与字段契约

杯赛每组以来源公开的完整球队成员集合哈希标识，不声称这是原生分组ID。每行由场次、组成员哈希、球队ID唯一确定。保留排名、赛胜平负、进失球、净胜球和积分；Nowscore未列净胜球时，以进球减失球显式推导并标注依据。缺页/缺表不补零，来源公开的零场次、零积分照实保存。

```{python}
#| include: false
import json
from pathlib import Path
from beidan_backend.cup_standings import parse_cup_standings,reconcile_cup_standings
raw_root=Path(r.raw_input);out=Path(r.output)
receipts=json.loads((raw_root/'raw-receipts.json').read_text())
fixtures=json.loads((out/'base-fixtures.json').read_text())
parsed_sources=[]
for fixture in fixtures:
 for source in ('titan','nowscore'):
  matches=[p for p in receipts if p['fixture_id']==fixture['fixture_id'] and p['source']==source and '/analysis/' in p['url']]
  assert len(matches)==1
  captured=matches[0]
  receipt={k:captured[k] for k in ('source','url','sha256')}
  receipt['observed_at']=captured['capture_observed_at']
  parsed_sources.append(parse_cup_standings((raw_root/captured['path']).read_bytes(),fixture_id=fixture['fixture_id'],source=source,identity=fixture,receipt=receipt))
preview=reconcile_cup_standings(parsed_sources)
(out/'preview.json').write_text(json.dumps(preview,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
assert len(preview['coverage'])==292
```

```{r}
preview <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(output,"preview.json"))
source_rows <- as_tibble(preview$source_standings)
effective <- as_tibble(preview$standings)
coverage <- as_tibble(preview$coverage)
reconciliation <- as_tibble(preview$reconciliation)
stopifnot(nrow(source_rows)==390L,nrow(effective)==195L,n_distinct(effective$fixture_id)==43L,all(effective$state=="AGREEMENT"))
coverage |> count(source,state)
source_rows |> filter(source=="titan") |> select(fixture_id,team_id,team_name,rank,played,points,goal_difference) |> slice_head(n=6)
source_rows |> filter(source=="nowscore") |> select(fixture_id,team_id,team_name,rank,played,points,goal_difference) |> slice_head(n=6)
reconciliation |> count(state)
```

## 整期覆盖变化

```{r}
target_cup <- effective |> left_join(base |> select(fixture_id,home_id,away_id),by="fixture_id",relationship="many-to-one") |> filter(team_id==home_id|team_id==away_id)
cup_count <- target_cup |> count(fixture_id)
stopifnot(nrow(cup_count)==43L,all(cup_count$n==2L))
ranked <- union(unique(league$fixture_id),cup_count$fixture_id)
before_after <- tibble(metric=c("整期场次","既有双方联赛积分","可恢复杯赛小组积分","联赛或小组积分覆盖"),before=c(146L,n_distinct(league$fixture_id),0L,n_distinct(league$fixture_id)),after=c(146L,n_distinct(league$fixture_id),nrow(cup_count),length(ranked)))
before_after
stopifnot(length(ranked)==134L)
audit <- readr::read_csv(file.path(previous,"data/fixture-audit.csv"),show_col_types=FALSE,col_types=cols(fixture_id=col_character(),provider_id=col_character(),home_id=col_character(),away_id=col_character()))
stopifnot(nrow(problems(audit))==0L)
remaining <- audit |> filter(!fixture_id%in%ranked) |> select(fixture_id,home,away,competition,standing_review)
remaining
write_csv(before_after,file.path(output,"coverage-before-after.csv"))
write_csv(remaining,file.path(output,"remaining.csv"))
```

剩余12场中，6场国际友谊不适用联赛积分榜；6场亚运的阶段由下述独立材料补充。本轮只入库来源杯赛表，不把缺少当前阶段小组表解释为没有此前小组赛资料。阿根廷杯#131已有双方联赛排名，但不把它描述为杯赛小组积分。#135精确实际时间、本场及历史比赛的赛事/中立场标准化字段仍按原goal继续处理。

## 亚运阶段及时间冲突的补充核验

```{r}
evidence_path <- file.path(root,cfg$external_evidence_relative)
stopifnot(digest::digest(file=evidence_path,algo="sha256")==cfg$external_evidence_sha256)
evidence <- jsonlite::fromJSON(evidence_path)
for(i in seq_len(nrow(evidence$files))) stopifnot(digest::digest(file=file.path(root,evidence$files$path[i]),algo="sha256")==evidence$files$sha256[i])
stages <- as_tibble(evidence$stages)
stage_check <- stages |> left_join(base |> select(fixture_id,base_provider_id=provider_id),by="fixture_id",relationship="one-to-one")
stopifnot(nrow(stage_check)==6L,!anyNA(stage_check$base_provider_id),all(stage_check$provider_id==stage_check$base_provider_id),all(stage_check$status=="SUPPORTED_BY_PRIMARY_REPORT"))
stages |> select(fixture_id,stage,current_group_table_applicability,status)
remaining_classified <- remaining |> left_join(stages |> select(fixture_id,stage,current_group_table_applicability),by="fixture_id",relationship="one-to-one")
write_csv(remaining_classified,file.path(output,"remaining-classified.csv"))
evidence$files |> as_tibble() |> select(path,content_state,availability_class)
```

三篇亚足联正文明确对应比赛为四分之一决赛，分别覆盖[男足首日](https://www.the-afc.com/en/more/asian_games.html/news/ag-m-uzbekistan-korea-republic-one-step-closer)、[男足次日](https://www.the-afc.com/en/more/asian_games.html/news/ag-m-china-pr-japan-march-into-semis)及[女足](https://www.the-afc.com/en/more/asian_games.html/news/ag-w-four-remain-in-the-hunt)。阶段映射是逐场证据，不是对所有杯赛的统一推断。官方汇总PDF的阅读代理返回上游404，已单列失败，不能当作成功取得积分或赛果。

#135的[俱乐部官方日历](https://clubnecaxa.mx/partidos/calendario/APERTURA-2026)写当地21:00，另一篇[独立预告](https://futnsoccer.com/2026/09/26/where-to-watch-necaxa-vs-club-america/)给出的时间对应当地21:10。现在确认不同来源的计划时间口径确有差异，仍未裁决实际开球时间，不移动原冻结截止。女足#2的官方报道明确最后1–0发生于加时第109分钟，常规时间为0–0；该证据未用于修改结算或冻结预测。

上述正文保留的是Jina代理原始文本响应，不声称保存了目标网站原始HTML。公布日期仅作来源声称，采集发生在赛后，全部仍为历史代理。

## 发布及回读

`publish=false`只做解析预览；`publish=true`必须读取与本次源快照匹配的完整验收收据，然后通过R包发布。正式数据集为`source_cup_standings_26098`，五张表分别保存来源、有效积分、覆盖、逐字段核对、溯源。源分组集合不一致时整组隔离；单元格不一致时仅该格为空。

```{r}
if (isTRUE(params$publish)) {
 checks_path <- file.path(root,"results/26098-cup-standings-20261018/final-checks.json")
 checks <- jsonlite::fromJSON(checks_path)
 stopifnot(checks$package_snapshot_sha256==digest::digest(file=file.path(root,cfg$verification_snapshot),algo="sha256"),all(checks$checks$exit_status==0L),all(checks$checks$skipped==0L))
 for(i in seq_len(nrow(checks$files))) stopifnot(digest::digest(file=file.path(root,checks$files$path[i]),algo="sha256")==checks$files$sha256[i])
 result <- beidan::publish_cup_standings(reticulate::py$parsed_sources,issue=cfg$issue,base_version=cfg$base_version,base_manifest_sha256=cfg$base_manifest_sha256,raw_evidence_relative=cfg$raw_evidence_relative,raw_manifest_sha256=cfg$raw_manifest_sha256,python=python,root=nas,hot_root=hot)
 published <- list()
 for(table in c("source_standings","standings","coverage","reconciliation","provenance")) {
  published[[table]] <- beidan::read_dataset(result$dataset,table,version=result$version,root=nas,verify=TRUE)
  stopifnot(is_tibble(published[[table]]),nrow(published[[table]])==nrow(as_tibble(preview[[table]])))
 }
 stopifnot(nrow(published$standings)==195L,all(published$standings$state=="AGREEMENT"),is.integer(published$standings$points),inherits(published$provenance$observed_at,"POSIXct"),sum(is.na(published$coverage$team_rows))==206L)
 replay <- beidan::publish_cup_standings(reticulate::py$parsed_sources,issue=cfg$issue,base_version=cfg$base_version,base_manifest_sha256=cfg$base_manifest_sha256,raw_evidence_relative=cfg$raw_evidence_relative,raw_manifest_sha256=cfg$raw_manifest_sha256,python=python,root=nas,hot_root=hot)
 stopifnot(replay$status=="unchanged",replay$version==result$version)
 jsonlite::write_json(list(publication=result,repeated_publication=replay,goal_complete=FALSE,base_dataset_modified=FALSE,package_snapshot_sha256=checks$package_snapshot_sha256,config_sha256=digest::digest(file=file.path(root,params$config_relative),algo="sha256")),file.path(root,"results/26098-cup-standings-20261018/publication.json"),auto_unbox=TRUE,pretty=TRUE)
 tibble(dataset=result$dataset,version=result$version,rows=nrow(published$standings),fixtures=n_distinct(published$standings$fixture_id),repeated_status=replay$status)
} else {
 tibble(state="PREVIEW_ONLY_NOT_PUBLISHED",goal_complete=FALSE)
}
```
